recalled_knowledge.item: Liquid-xenon work function W = 13.7 eV (older NEST v2 default, LUX Doke-plot analyses) and 13.5 eV (other literature); nestpy 2.1.1 itself returns 13.44 eV

recalled_knowledge.item: Functional form of the NEST v2 NR yield model (Nq = alpha E^beta; Qy with the [epsilon + E^p]^-1 factor and field power law; Nph = Nq - Ne) used only to interpret the parameter variants; the numbers come from nestpy
10-90 % percentile range of a Gaussian = +-1.2816 sigma

failed_or_abandoned: Direct use of nestpy NESTcalc.GetS1/GetS2 (17/16 positional arguments incl. positions, drift time and PMT vectors; would impose the detector object's g1 = 0.1122 and g2 = 34.02) - replaced by an explicit binomial/Fano detector model with the paper's g1 = 0.110 and g2 = 34.5
Contour-crossing digitisation from Fig. 2 - AmBe calibration points create spurious crossings at 454, 483, 513 phd; Fig. 4 used (identical band and contours), Fig. 2 retained only for the band lines
Initial contour colour mask (dark slate grey of the labels) found no contour pixels; the rendered contour colour is (150,166,166)
Forcing the MC band width onto the drawn 10-90 % percentiles - abandoned; the NEST-2.1.1 band (sigma = 0.033 dex) is 1.5x wider than the drawn one (0.022 dex) and both are reported
